SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SPECIAL BRANCH REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY Section 2 Station 2554/10 Date 15 - 7 - 32 July 15th 32）

Subject (in full) Conference of Kiangsu Representatives of Anti-Imperialist
Organizations - July 15.

Made by D. I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by old branch

According to information received from the Chinese
Authorities, the Conference of Kiangsu Representatives of
Anti-Imperialist Organizations - July 15 - will be held at the
China Public School, 1260 Rue Lafayette, the Chinan University,
56 Hart Road, and the Great China University, Chun San Road,
O.O.L. It is, however, generally believed that the
meeting will be convened at the Medium Club (中社), 150
Weihaiwei Road, at 2 p.m. July 15.
Further enquiries are proceeding and it is hoped
to secure more definite information at an early hour.

（批：yl.）

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：This file has been seen by O/C. S.B.; for remarks see D. 3719.）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

SPECIAL BRANCH
------        July 18, 1932.

Intelligence Report

Political

Arrest of participants of Meeting of Kiangsu Representatives
of anti-Imperialist Organizations

Following unsuccessful attempts to find a suitable
venue to hold a meeting of Kiangsu Representatives of
Anti-Imperialistic organizations, the promoters, the
"Federation of Shanghai People to Oppose the Agreement to
Cease Hostilities and Support the North Eastern Volunteer
Armies" convened the meeting in the Kung Wu Tai Theatre,
69 Robison Road (O.O.L.) at 8.30 a.m. July 17 despite the
theatre management's refusal to permit its place being
used for this purpose and without any application to the
Chinese Authorities for their sanction. In consequence
the theatre was raided by Chinese police and 93 participants
were arrested. The prisoners are being held by the Public
Safety Bureau for examination, as although the literature
seized at the meeting confines itself to attacks on the
"Kuomintang Government", "the Imperialists" and the Japanese,
it is suspected that the Chinese Communist Party is behind
the movement. One important item for elucidation is the
manner of distribution and destination of a fund which the
Federation has been collecting recently to assist the
so-called North Eastern Volunteer Armies :

The arrested persons include students of the following
educational institutions :-

Chinan University, 56 Hart Road and at Chenju
Great China University, 5454 Chung San Road
China Public School, 1260 Rue Lafayette
Central University, Nanking
Commercial Public School, Avenue Joffre
Futan University, Avenue Haig, O.O.L.

上海公共租界工部局警务处

特别支部
------        1932年7月18日。

情报报告

政治类

逮捕反帝组织江苏省代表会议参与者

在寻找合适场地举行反帝组织江苏省代表会议的尝试失败后，发起方“上海民众反对停战协定及支援东北义勇军联合会”不顾剧院管理方拒绝将其场所用于此目的，且未向中国当局申请许可，于7月17日上午8时30分在罗宾森路69号（越界筑路区）的共舞台剧院召开了会议。因此，中国警察突袭了该剧院，逮捕了93名参与者。囚犯正被公安局扣留审讯，因为虽然在会议上查获的宣传品仅限于攻击“国民党政府”、“帝国主义者”和日本，但怀疑中国共产党是此次运动背后的推手。需要澄清的一个重要事项是该联合会最近为援助所谓的东北义勇军而筹集的资金的分发方式和去向：

被捕人员包括以下教育机构的学生：-

哈同路56号及陈居的暨南大学
中山路5454号的大夏大学
拉斐特路1260号的中国公学
南京中央大学
霞飞路的商业公学
海格路（越界筑路区）的复旦大学

page_data.en:
The following is a summarized translation of the literature
seized by the Chinese Police at this meeting place :-
1. Handbill entitled "Brief Regulations of the "Kiangsu
Provincial Anti-Japanese and Imperialist Federation",
stating that the aim of the Federation is to effect the
emancipation of the Chinese nation by uniting the masses
and conducting Anti-Imperialist and Anti-Japanese Movements.
2. Handbill entitled "Advice to Representatives", denouncing
the Kuomintang Government for having betrayed national
rights and alleging that the various imperialistic Powers
are planning an attack upon Soviet Russia.
3. Handbill entitled "Draft of a manifesto of the Representatives'
Meeting of the Kiangsu Provincial Anti-Imperialist and Anti-
Japanese Federation", denouncing the Kuomintang and
Imperialists.
4. Blank form for joining the "Dare-to-Die Corps" to carry out
anti-Japanese and anti-Imperialist activities.
5. Handbill urging the Anti-Imperialist masses to send
representatives to attend (1) the General Meeting of
Kiangsu Anti-Imperialist Representatives of July 15 and
(2) the General Meeting of Representatives of Anti-Imperialist
Youth of July 24.
6. Blank form for joining the "Dare-to-Die Corps to proceed to the
North-East to assist the Volunteer Armies in Manchuria".
page_data.zh:
以下是中国警察在此会议地点查获的宣传品的摘要译文：-
1. 题为《江苏省反日反帝联合会简要章程》的传单，声明该联合会的目标是通过团结群众并开展反帝和反日运动来实现中华民族的解放。
2. 题为《告代表书》的传单，谴责国民党政府出卖国家权利，并指控各帝国主义列强正策划进攻苏维埃俄国。
3. 题为《江苏省反帝反日联合会代表会议宣言草案》的传单，谴责国民党和帝国主义者。
4. 加入执行反日和反帝活动的“敢死队”的空白报名表。
5. 呼吁反帝群众派遣代表参加（1）7月15日的江苏省反帝代表全体会议和（2）7月24日的反帝青年代表全体会议的传单。
6. 加入“敢死队前往东北援助满洲义勇军”的空白报名表。

page_data.en:
Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 16/7/32.

Federation of Shanghai People - Kiangsu Provincial
Representatives Meeting fails to materialize.

The Kiangsu Representative Meeting sponsored by the
Federation of Shanghai People to Oppose the Agreement to
Cease Hostilities and to Support the North Eastern Volunteer
Armies did not take place on July 15 as originally arranged.
Four places were suggested as suitable for the holding of this
meeting but in each case permission was refused.

It is reported that about six representatives who
claimed to have come from Soochow and other places as well
as ten Chinese representing the students of the Chinan
University and Great China University and the Ricsha
Coolies' Union visited the office of the Federation
during the day.
page_data.zh:
1932年7月16日每日情报报告摘录。

上海民众联合会 - 江苏省代表会议未能举行。

由“上海民众反对停战协定及支援东北义勇军联合会”赞助的江苏省代表会议未按原计划于7月15日举行。曾提议四个地点作为举行此会议的合适场所，但在每种情况下许可均被拒绝。

据报道，约有六名自称来自苏州及其他地方的代表，以及十名代表暨南大学和大夏大学学生及黄包车夫工会的中国人，当天访问了该联合会的办公室。

page_data.en:
Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 15/7/32

Federation of Shanghai People to Oppose the Agreement to
Cease Hostilities and to support the North Eastern
Volunteer Armies - proposed meeting for 2 p.m. July 15

According to information secured, the "Federation of
Shanghai People to Oppose the 'Agreement to Cease Hostilities'
and to support the North Eastern Volunteer Armies" have not
yet decided on the exact venue of the Kiangsu Provincial
Representative Meeting to be held at 2 p.m. today, July 15,
but it is reported that the following three places have been
selected as possible meeting places :-

(1) Medium Club, 150 Weihaiwei Road.
(2) Chinan University, 56 Hart Road.
(3) China Public School, 1260 Rue Lafayette.
page_data.zh:
1932年7月15日每日情报报告摘录

上海民众反对停战协定及支援东北义勇军联合会 - 拟于7月15日下午2时举行的会议

根据获得的情报，“上海民众反对‘停战协定’及支援东北义勇军联合会”尚未决定定于今天（7月15日）下午2时举行的江苏省代表会议的确切地点，但据报道，已选定以下三个地点作为可能的会议场所：-

(1) 威海卫路150号的中社（Medium Club）。
(2) 哈同路56号的暨南大学。
(3) 拉斐特路1260号的中国公学。

Demonstrations planned to take place on July 10, 1932.

Report made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa on July 10, 1932.:

At 9 a.m. July 9, eleven representatives of workers
of various factories in the Western District attended a secret
meeting convened by a communist organization known as the
Mutual Aid Society (互濟會), in a straw hut off Penang Road,
O.O.L. Resolutions were passed that all workers be urged
to participate in a demonstration scheduled to take place
X
on Boundary Road near the Shanghai North Station at 9 a.m.
July 10, to demand the release of Mr. and Mrs. Noulens.

According to information received from another source,
communistic elements will gather at the corner of North Honan
and Range Roads at 4 p.m. July 10 from where they will enter
Chapel to participate in a demonstration against the trial of
Mr. and Mrs. Noulens. It is reported that the number of
participants will be as follows :

500 workers from Western District, 300 workers from
French Concession and Nantao, 200 workers from
Eastern District and 200 students.

It is further reported that the leader of the demons-
tration is to be distinguished by his smoking a cigarette
held between the fingers of the right hand with the palm of
the hand facing outwards and the left arm held across the
chest.

计划于1932年7月10日举行的示威活动。

特别巡长顾保华于1932年7月10日提交的报告：

7月9日上午9时，西区各工厂的十一名工人代表参加了由一个名为互济会（Mutual Aid Society）的共产主义组织在越界筑路区槟榔路附近的一间草棚内召开的秘密会议。会议通过决议，敦促所有工人参加定于7月10日上午9时在上海北站附近的界路举行的示威活动，要求释放牛兰夫妇。

根据从另一来源获得的情报，共产主义分子将于7月10日下午4时在河南北路与雷音路转角处聚集，并从那里进入教堂区（Chapel），参加反对审判牛兰夫妇的示威活动。据报道，参与人数如下：

西区工人500名，法租界和南市工人300名，东区工人200名和学生200名。

另据报道，示威领导者的识别特征是：右手手指夹着香烟，手掌向外，左臂横在胸前。

Date July 7th 1932

Subject (in full) Communist Meeting held in the Western District, O.O.L.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [Signature]

Some 21 Western District workers attended a meeting
held in a straw hut situated in Chinese territory off Penang
Road between 9 and 11 a.m. July 7. A communist representative
named Siao Liu (小刘) presided and the following resolutions
were proposed and passed :-
(1) That the celebration of the anniversary of the "Inauguration
of the 1st Conference of the Red Labour International,"
which falls on July 9, be postponed until the next day
July 10. (Venue not mentioned)
(2) That the term "Western District" be changed to "Special
District" and that Chow Ka Jao (周家桥) be henceforth
known as the "Western Shanghai District."
(3) That arrangements be made to organize a "Red Army Friendly
Society" (红军之友社) and that the object of this society
will be to gradually absorb the local labouring masses into
the ranks of the Chinese Red Army.
(4) That preparations be made to hold a general conference of
anti-imperialist representatives on July 15. (Venue not
mentioned).

I forward herewith a handbill, together with a
summarized translation of same, which relates to the proposed
conference mentioned in the 4th resolution.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

[Handwritten notes at bottom:]
S. O. "B",
Information and form of
return.
8 JULY 1932

主题（全称） 在越界筑路区西区举行的共产主义会议。

由特别巡长顾保华呈报。由 [签名] 转递

约21名西区工人参加了7月7日上午9时至11时在槟榔路外中国领土内的一间草棚内举行的会议。一位名叫小刘（Siao Liu）的共产主义代表主持了会议，并提出并通过了以下决议：-
(1) 将庆祝“红色劳工国际第一次大会开幕”周年纪念日（适逢7月9日）推迟至次日7月10日。（未提及地点）
(2) 将“西区”一词改为“特区”，此后周家桥（Chow Ka Jao）被称为“上海西区”。
(3) 安排组织“红军之友社”（Red Army Friendly Society），该社团的目标是逐步将当地劳动群众吸收进中国红军的队伍。
(4) 准备于7月15日举行反帝代表全体会议。（未提及地点）。

现随函附上一份传单及其摘要译文，内容涉及第4项决议中提到的拟议会议。

顾保华
特别巡长

page_data.en:
Translation of a handbill entitled "Letter to Labourers
in connection with the 'Conference of Anti-Imperialist
Representatives' to be held on July 15, 1932," purporting
to emanate from the Western District Committee.
(Copies of this handbill were obtained by the Municipal
Police in the western district on July 7.)

Labourers !

A conference of anti-imperialist representatives
of the Kiangsu Province will be held on July 7. We
should therefore hasten to hold meetings for the
purpose of selecting representatives to attend this
conference and in this manner accelerate the anti-
imperialist movement.

Labourers !

The Imperialists, the Kuomintang and all
Capitalists are strengthening their positions with
the object of launching an attack upon the Red Army
and all Soviet Districts. They have mobilized over
seventy armies for this purpose and in addition have
bought over numerous "running dogs" to oppress us
and deprive us of our rights.

Labourers !

Whilst the imperialists are thus contemplating their
4th oppression upon the Red Army, our wages have been
reduced by 10%, our work has been doubled and workers
are dismissed in large numbers. Besides this our
rice allowance and bonus has also been decreased.
Is this not the "blood suckers" method of sucking blood?

Labourers, our blood has been sucked and we are on
the verge of death. Rise and unite !

The following are our slogans :

(1) Hold meetings in your quarters and select represent-
atives to attend the coming conference.

(2) Oppose the 10% reduction in pay.
page_data.zh:
题为《致劳工书——关于1932年7月15日举行的“反帝代表会议”》的传单译文，声称出自西区委员会。
（工部局警务处于7月7日在西区获得了此传单的副本。）

劳工们！

江苏省反帝代表会议将于7月7日举行。因此，我们应迅速召开会议，选举代表参加此次会议，以此加速反帝运动。

劳工们！

帝国主义者、国民党和所有资本家正在加强其地位，目的是向红军和所有苏维埃区发动进攻。为此他们动员了七十多个军队，此外还收买了无数“走狗”来压迫我们，剥夺我们的权利。

劳工们！

当帝国主义者如此策划对红军的第四次压迫时，我们的工资减少了10%，工作量加倍，大量工人被解雇。此外，我们的米贴和奖金也减少了。这难道不是“吸血鬼”吸血的方法吗？

劳工们，我们的血被吸干，我们处于死亡边缘。起来团结吧！

以下是我们的口号：

(1) 在各街区召开会议，选举代表参加即将举行的会议。

(2) 反对减薪10%。

page_data.en:
(2)

(3) Oppose additional work.
(4) Oppose increased working hours.
(5) Oppose the dismissal of workers and demand their
reinstatement.
(6) Oppose the cancellation of rice allowance and bonus.
(7) Oppose the attack upon the red army by the
imperialistic Kuomintang and give armed support
to the red army and to Soviet districts.
(8) Ling live the Conference of Anti-Imperialist
representatives of the Kiangsu Province.

Western Special District Committee
July 5, 1932.
